description: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs lines 336-339: check_algorithm and check_extensions run before validate_path. A chain with an algorithm error AND an extension violation will return AlgorithmNotAllowed, not an extension error — which is correct priority. However a chain that passes the algorithm whitelist but fails inner signature verification (e.g., wrong key) will return an extension or structural error from check_extensions if any extension is non-conforming. More importantly: the order is undocumented. The function's rustdoc Errors section lists the error variants but does not specify which check runs first, so callers cannot predict which error they get when multiple violations exist. This should be documented.
title: verify_simple runs check_extensions before validate_path, masking algorithm errors
